metrics.label: ROIC
metrics.note: Return on invested capital: after-tax profit per $ of capital deployed. Core quality marker.

metrics.label: ROIC 5y
metrics.note: 5-year average ROIC: shows whether high returns are durable, not a one-off.

metrics.label: Operating margin
metrics.note: Operating margin: operating profit / revenue. Pricing power and cost discipline.

metrics.label: FCF margin 5y
metrics.note: 5-year average free-cash-flow margin: FCF / revenue. How much cash the model throws off.

metrics.label: FCF/Net income conv.
metrics.note: Cash conversion: free cash flow / net income. >100% = earnings are backed by real cash.

metrics.label: Gross margin
metrics.note: 5-year average gross margin (low weight: strongly sector-biased, 100% is often an artefact).

metrics.label: Low dilution
metrics.note: Share count 5y CAGR. Lower/negative = buybacks, no dilution (scored inverted).

metrics.label: Low SBC/Revenue
metrics.note: Stock-based comp / revenue. Hidden cost of equity pay; lower is better (scored inverted).

metrics.label: Low leverage
metrics.note: Net debt / EBITDA. Balance-sheet leverage; lower is safer (scored inverted).

metrics.label: Interest coverage
metrics.note: Interest coverage: EBIT / interest expense. How easily debt interest is paid.

metrics.label: Current ratio
metrics.note: Current ratio: current assets / current liabilities. Short-term solvency.

metrics.label: Low LT debt
metrics.note: Long-term debt / assets. Structural indebtedness; lower is better (scored inverted).

metrics.label: Capex coverage
metrics.note: Capex coverage: operating cash flow / capex. >1 = self-funding of investments.

metrics.label: Revenue growth 5y
metrics.note: Revenue 5-year CAGR. Historical top-line growth.

metrics.label: Fwd revenue growth
metrics.note: Expected revenue 3-year forward CAGR (analyst estimates).
metrics.unavailableReason: Not published for this company, so its weight is spread over the metrics that are.

metrics.label: FCF growth 5y
metrics.note: Levered free cash flow 5-year CAGR. Growth of the cash that actually reaches shareholders.
metrics.unavailableReason: Not published for this company, so its weight is spread over the metrics that are.

metrics.label: Net income growth 5y
metrics.note: Net income 5-year CAGR. Bottom-line growth.

metrics.label: Revenue/share growth 5y
metrics.note: Revenue growth adjusted for changes in share count. How much top-line growth accrues per share.

metrics.label: FCF/share growth 5y
metrics.note: FCF growth adjusted for changes in share count. The cash growth that actually accrues per share.
metrics.unavailableReason: Not published for this company, so its weight is spread over the metrics that are.

metrics.label: Attractive EV/EBIT
metrics.note: EV / EBIT. Enterprise value vs operating profit; lower is cheaper (scored inverted).

metrics.label: Attractive EV/FCF
metrics.note: EV / free cash flow. Cheapness on a cash basis; lower is better (scored inverted).

metrics.label: Attractive P/FCF fwd
metrics.note: Forward price / free cash flow. Forward-looking cheapness; lower is better (scored inverted).
metrics.unavailableReason: Not published for this company, so its weight is spread over the metrics that are.

metrics.label: FCF yield
metrics.note: FCF yield: free cash flow / market cap. Higher = more cash return for the price paid.
